title: Order bread for pickup in three screens

fields.summary: As a customer of the bakery, I want to order bread for pickup in three screens and know the order went through, so that ordering feels quick and trustworthy.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [recording] state: `/order` as the seeded customer with an empty basket; expected: choosing one loaf, a pickup time, and paying reaches the order confirmation in at most 3 screens
2. [screenshot] state: the order confirmation after the seeded customer pays; expected: the order number and the chosen pickup time are shown
3. [screenshot] state: `/order/review` with the seeded basket of 2 items; expected: the total price and the pickup time are shown above the "Pay now" button
4. [recording] state: `/order/review` when the seeded payment stub declines the payment; expected: an error message and a "Try again" button appear on the same screen and the basket still holds its 2 items
5. [screenshot] state: each of the 3 order screens at 390 px and 1280 px wide; expected: the screen shows without horizontal scrolling at both widths
6. [screenshot] state: each of the 3 order screens; expected: colours, spacing, and type come only from the `--crumb-` tokens in `web/styles/tokens.css`, and the controls are the existing Button and Stepper components
fields.scenario: As the seeded customer, open /order with an empty basket, choose one loaf, choose a pickup time and enter details on the second screen, review and pay on the third; repeat with the payment stub set to decline; capture each screen at 390 px and 1280 px.
fields.environment: local app with the seeded synthetic customer and the payment stub; never production
fields.assumptions:
- The seeded data includes a payment stub that can be set to decline a payment.
- The order confirmation is a new screen; its order number comes from POST /api/orders.
- Loading stays as it is today (web/app/order/loading.tsx); offline handling is out of scope.
fields.open_questions:
- answered: which task first (a first order for pickup, ending on a confirmation)
- deferred: the exact wording of the confirmation and the payment error message (the human writes it with the shop staff; the build uses placeholders they review)
fields.parked_ideas: - loyalty stamp card: every tenth loaf free, shown on the confirmation (raised by grill; the human parked it)
fields.provenance:
Request: "The bakery app needs high-quality UX for ordering. It belongs under Feature #40 (Online ordering)."
Vague: "high-quality UX" → criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
1. confirmed (ux.steps): "Three screens at most"; facts: flow:/order
2. stated (ux.tasks): "they see an order number and the pickup time"; facts: route:/api/orders
3. stated (ux.trust): "Show the total price and the pickup time on the review screen before they pay"; facts: route:/order/review, component:BasketSummary
4. confirmed (ux.states): "keep the basket and show a message with a Try again button on the same screen"; facts: gap:error:/order
5. default (ux.platforms): "Your default is fine."; facts: floor:platforms
6. confirmed (ux.consistency): "Only our existing tokens and components"; facts: tokens:web/styles/tokens.css, component:Button, component:Stepper
